source: Planted for stage-bench: a CLI whose docs are published from main by a Pages workflow.

issue.title: --shout flag
issue.body:
Support folks asked for a louder greeting for the lobby screen.

Expect:
- node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints the greeting in upper case
- without --shout the output is unchanged
- docs/index.md documents --shout
- after merge, the published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ lists --shout
expect: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints the greeting in upper case
after merge, the published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ lists --shout

trap: A line not checkable before merge (planted): .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ only on a push to main, so the page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ cannot show --shout while the PR is open. A verifier that reads the live page sees today's page.
must_catch: The verifier check for line 4 says the published page can only change after merge, and checks at the PR head what will publish it (docs/index.md lists --shout, and .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ from main), rather than reading the live page.
The verifier check for line 2 compares output without --shout to the output before the change (for example the base commit's bin/greet.js), not only to a hand-written expected string.
must_not: A check for line 4 that fetches the live page and PASSes or FAILs on what it shows today.
A check for line 4 that silently PASSes with no evidence.
